Lines 1841-1972 (_rd_covers_derive and its awk grammar) and 1401-1694 (issues_due_gate) belong to slice S5 and are NOT
frozen here. The S4 differential assembles head + section + blocked_body + blocked + derive + degraded + scan + resolve +
counters + focuses + bu + next-a, then two authored stand-ins defined inside the --next block (issues_due_gate prints
`_stop_exhausted`; _rd_covers_derive keeps the declared counter), then next-b and an authored tail for the other modes. The
Go side runs the same stand-ins through its seams. verify-state.sh is staged as a wrapper that re-executes the Go test
binary as `rsdd verify state` (or prints a fixed report for the first-failure cases).
